summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for BahanPas AI. All 4 AI endpoints (parse-voice, parse-receipt, margin-advice, reorder) pass pytest with Emergent LLM key. All critical frontend flows work: Landing + Pitch Deck 4 slides, Login (form + bypass, wrong creds toast), Dashboard (4 KPIs, slider, FIFO, savings chart, get-ai-advice), Smart Entry (voice-sample-0 -> parsed-result -> confirm apply, sample-receipt -> receipt-result, HPP), Sales/Audit (all 3 tabs, submit-sales, mandatory waste-reason validation, audit-trail), Reorder (run-analysis, copy-wa, send-wa), global header (quick-demo, pitch-deck, reset, theme-toggle switches dark class), localStorage persistence (bahanpas_auth and bahanpas_state_v1).

issues: Low contrast on secondary text in KPI cards (e.g., 'Nilai stok Rp 841.000', '+1 batch waspada', 'Dari FIFO & audit waste', '2 menu aktif') and recipe rows (Kopi Susu Aren / Vanilla Latte sub-labels) — appears near-invisible dark grey on dark background. Bump muted-foreground to a lighter shade in dark theme.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial paint (charts still render). Consider giving the chart wrapper an explicit minHeight to avoid warnings.

action_items: Improve dark-mode text contrast for muted/secondary labels on Dashboard KPI cards and recipe rows.
Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer initial width warnings (add minHeight to chart container).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id (endpoints don't touch Mongo docs). Uses env vars for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Good JSON extraction fallback with regex + code-fence stripping.
Voice parse returns '_raw' echo of raw LLM output — small privacy/noise concern; consider stripping before returning.
No rate-limiting on AI endpoints — acceptable for MVP demo but note for production.
Frontend Protected route only checks localStorage — matches design intent (client-side bypass auth for demo).
seed_data_creation: None — app uses built-in seed via localStorage key bahanpas_state_v1
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (6 tests, all pass in ~8s). Frontend testids are stable and match request. Waste log testids are on the 'audit' tab: waste-ingredient, waste-qty, waste-unit, waste-reason, submit-waste-btn, audit-trail. Sales counters use +/- buttons (sale-plus-/sale-minus-/sale-count-<slug>) not raw number inputs. Only remaining polish item is dark-mode contrast on Dashboard secondary text.
